_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED BY THE 8/27 PRE-CLOSE. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, AND THE REASON IS THAT NOTHING HAS PASSED YET: the MRVL row's event is TONIGHT, after this close, so at 15:35 it is still AHEAD and deleting it now would be deleting a forecast rather than a fact. It is re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull at 15:36 - MRVL, 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027, no actual yet. THE 8/28 OPEN OWNS REMOVING IT once the number is out, and that assignment is written here rather than assumed. ITS SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE RATHER THAN CARRIED, AND THE REFRESH IS ITSELF A FINDING. MRVL is 242.56 bid / 242.79 ask at 2026-08-27T19:35:39.384360804Z, last 242.720, against a 245.110 settled close - DOWN 1.04% on the session. At 09:50 this row carried 247.03 and MRVL was UP 0.78%. It has reversed 4.47 points intraday and goes into its own print RED, on a session where NVDA led the complex higher. That is information about positioning into the number and it changes NOTHING about the refusal, which rests on the gap and not on the direction - which is precisely why the spot is refreshed rather than the branch rewritten. AMD sat on this board at 522.95 the morning it traded at 486; a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong, and this row is now three sessions old. BRANCH THREE OF THE MRVL ROW FELL DUE ON THIS EXACT RUN AND IS DISCHARGED WITH NOTHING TO DECIDE. It reads that the 8/27 pre-close decides any open position from an unrelated setup explicitly against this row, and that a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first. Both position lists returned EMPTY on a live pull at 15:35, so there is no unrelated position to decide, no hold to place a straddle before, and impliedMove stays null as a DISCHARGED check rather than an outstanding one. A number quoted for a position nobody will take measures nothing. AVGO WAS ADDED AS A NEW ROW, on a live pull rather than from memory: AVGO, 2026-09-02, timing pm, verified true, estimate 3.16 for fiscal Q3 2026, no actual yet, spot 369.36 bid / 369.43 ask at 19:37:15.219392724Z, last 369.375, +3.87% against a 355.590 close. Two reasons. First, it is the dated binary that will sit INSIDE the five-session time stop of anything this board opens between now and 9/2, which is the arithmetic that already refused AVGO itself as a candidate this morning - and a refusal that lives only in a candidates note is one the file loses the moment the note is rewritten. Second, with the MRVL row deleted tomorrow this file would otherwise be EMPTY, and a list of what is ahead with nothing ahead in it has stopped doing its job. The same live pull also shows a heavy 9/1-9/2 cluster behind it - PANW, DELL, CRDO, MDB and GTLB on 9/1 pm, then SNOW, HPE, NTAP and AVGO on 9/2 pm - which is named here so the 8/28 and 8/31 opens size their time stops knowing it.

moves.source: RE-VERIFIED AND SPOT-REFRESHED BY THE 8/27 PRE-CLOSE AT 15:35, THE LAST RUN BEFORE THE PRINT. Live earnings-calendar pull: MRVL, 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027, no actual yet - unchanged from the 8/25, 8/26 and 8/27-open pulls. THE EVENT IS TONIGHT, AFTER THIS CLOSE, which is why this row is NOT pruned today; it is still ahead. The 8/28 open owns removing it. SPOT IS A LIVE QUOTE AND NOT CARRIED: 242.56 bid / 242.79 ask at 2026-08-27T19:35:39.384360804Z on a 0.09% spread, last trade 242.720, against a 245.110 settled close - DOWN 1.04% on the session. THE DIRECTION REVERSED INSIDE THE DAY: at 09:50 this row read 247.03 and +0.78%, so MRVL has given up 4.47 points and goes into its own number RED, on a session where NVDA is up sharply and led the complex. The morning's reading was that the read-through being priced into MRVL was muted rather than euphoric; by the bell it is negative. That is information about positioning and it changes NOTHING about the refusal, which rests on the gap and not on the direction - a stop that cannot be honoured across an event gap cannot be honoured across a gap in either direction, and a name that sold off into its print is not thereby cheap. WHAT THIS ROW DID TODAY, RECORDED BECAUSE A BRANCH THAT NEVER BINDS IS NOT EVIDENCE OF ANYTHING: branch one refused ANET at 09:50 - a day-2 continuation of its own 8/26 breakout quoting a 0.103% spread with no earnings until 2026-11-03 and item 2 passing at +0.42%, the best setup on the tape by the run's own ranking. It also refused VRT, COHR, CRDO, ALAB, ARM, INTC, LSCC, KLAC, LRCX, TER, ONTO, MTSI, FORM and AMKR, and a re-strike of SMTC. The published entry, BOX, sat outside the complex entirely and expired unexecuted at 15:30. BRANCH THREE IS DISCHARGED BY THIS RUN WITH NOTHING TO DECIDE: both position lists returned EMPTY on a live pull at 15:35, so no unrelated position is exposed to tonight's gap and there is no hold for item 3 to bind on. impliedMove stays null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is a discharged check rather than an outstanding one - a number that was not pulled does not get written down as though it were.

branches.cond: An entry considered in MRVL itself, or in a semiconductor sympathy name, on 8/27 into this print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: This is the NVDA row's branch one applied to the second print rather than a new judgement, and it is written here so that deleting the NVDA row tomorrow does not delete the reasoning with it. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it - and refused SMTC a hold through tonight on the same item 3 test this morning. Nothing about MRVL's own move is the exposure being priced here; the exposure is that a stop cannot be honoured across a gap, in either direction, and one evening's rally does not change that arithmetic any more than one evening's sell-off does.

branches.cond: NVDA's print tonight moves MRVL hard before its own report tomorrow evening
branches.act: Not traded on that move, in either direction, before 8/28
branches.why: A sympathy gap on someone else's number, with the name's OWN dated binary still ahead of it the following evening, is the worst version of the setup this file exists to refuse: it takes the index gap without the index's liquidity, and then holds a second event on top of it. Cheapness after an NVDA miss is the MRVL binary being priced, not a support level, and strength after an NVDA beat is a continuation spike into a print, which item 2 calls a wait signal. The first point the rulebook can engage this name at all is the 8/28 session, after both numbers are known, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/27
branches.act: The 8/27 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: The same test the 8/26 pre-close applied to the NVDA row, restated here for the second print so the duty survives the first row being deleted. A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed and must not be closed early on a date that has nothing to do with it, but two semiconductor prints on consecutive evenings is precisely when correlation shows up in names that showed none for a month. Item 3 binds either way: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH an event belonging to another ticker whose gap it will nonetheless wear.

moves.source: ADDED 2026-08-27 BY THE PRE-CLOSE, on a live earnings-calendar pull rather than from memory: AVGO, 2026-09-02, timing pm, verified true, estimate 3.16 for fiscal Q3 2026, no actual yet. Spot is a live quote: 369.36 bid / 369.43 ask at 2026-08-27T19:37:15.219392724Z on a 0.02% spread, last 369.375, +3.87% against a 355.590 settled close. WHY IT IS PROMOTED TO ITS OWN ROW NOW RATHER THAN NOTICED ON 9/1. This is the dated binary that sits INSIDE the five-session time stop of anything opened between 8/27 and 9/2, and that arithmetic already did real work today: AVGO was the one mega-cap AI laggard that FITS the 40% single-name ceiling at 36.6% of a 1009.16 account, where AMD at 47.4%, AMAT at 47.6%, MU at 93.3%, TSM at 41.8% and SNPS at 42.7% are all blocked by size before any view reaches them - and it was refused anyway, on this date, because the hold would carry its own print. A refusal that lives only in a candidates note is one the file loses the next time that note is rewritten, which is exactly the failure the MRVL promotion was made to prevent on 8/26. THE 9/1-9/2 CLUSTER BEHIND IT IS NAMED HERE TOO, from the same pull: PANW, DELL, CRDO, MDB and GTLB report 9/1 pm, then SNOW, HPE, NTAP and AVGO on 9/2 pm. That is the semiconductor and enterprise-software complex reporting across two consecutive evenings, and BOX - the name this board specified today - is enterprise-software. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED: item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, both position lists are empty, and a number quoted for a position nobody holds measures nothing. It becomes owed the moment a position is open that would carry into 9/2. The 9/3 open owns pruning this row.

branches.cond: An entry considered in AVGO itself, or in a semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy name, whose five-session time stop would carry it through 2026-09-02
branches.act: Refused unless the position is sized and stopped to survive the gap, or is closed before the print by a pre-close run that says so explicitly
branches.why: This is the same arithmetic that refused AVGO this morning and SMCI on 8/12, applied forward to the date rather than rediscovered on 9/1. A -8% equity stop does not survive an event gap: the realistic bad case gaps THROUGH the exit rather than filling at it, so the stop is decorative and the real risk is the implied move, unpriced. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright. What makes this a branch rather than a blanket ban is the escape clause named in it - a position may still be opened if it is deliberately closed before the print, and the run that opens it must write that intention down at entry rather than discover the conflict on 9/1.

branches.cond: An entry is opened on or after 2026-08-28 whose time stop lands on or after 9/2, and the run wants to hold it through the print
branches.act: The ATM straddle is pulled and quoted first, or there is no hold
branches.why: Item 3 of the checklist, stated as a dated duty so that no run has to infer it. This board has a standing rule that a number which was not pulled does not exist, and item 3 is the place that rule is most often quietly skipped - because the straddle is only owed before a HOLD, it is tempting to treat the hold as already decided and the number as a formality. It is the other way round: the number decides the hold. SMCI was refused on exactly this reading when a 14.2% implied move was found to swallow an 8% stop.

branches.cond: AVGO gaps hard on 9/2 and the 9/3 open wants to trade the reaction
branches.act: Not on the reaction bar - the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is the entry, and item 2 governs
branches.why: Written now, six sessions early and with nothing at stake, for the same reason branch one of the MRVL row was widened on 8/21 before it cost anything: a pre-commitment made on the morning it binds is not a pre-commitment. The reaction day is not the entry this rulebook buys, and a +8% gap is a wait signal rather than a buy signal. NVDA on 8/27 is the worked example this board already has - it was refused at +7.33% on the reaction bar, a tenth of a point off the line, with the gap landing into the top of its own prior congestion.
